Three warning beacons on a radio mast blink together at the same instant at midnight. The mast is 54 meters tall. The red beacon blinks once every 18 seconds. The white beacon blinks once every 2 minutes. A fourth beacon, which blinks every 40 seconds, is switched off for repairs. A plane passes overhead about every 37 minutes. The amber beacon blinks once every 1 minute and 12 seconds. Counting that first moment, how many times do all three blink at the same instant during the first 41 minutes and 38 seconds?

Corner Loaf bakes 101 loaves a day, each using 400 grams of flour. Mill Street Bakery bakes 59 loaves a day, each using 50% more flour than one of Corner Loaf's loaves. A 10-kg sack of rye flour costs $39. Each loaf bakes for 33 minutes. Mill Street Bakery sells each loaf for $5. Flour comes only in whole 10-kg sacks at $32 per sack. If the two bakeries place one joint order with just enough whole sacks to cover 13 days of baking, how many dollars does the order cost?

At midnight, the north tank contains 650 liters of water and the south tank contains 762 liters. Water from the mains costs 6 cents per liter. The hose is 11 meters long. Each tank can hold up to 900 liters. From midnight on, a valve drains the south tank at 180 liters per hour, and a crack in the north tank leaks 1 liters per minute. 20 minutes after midnight, a hose starts filling the north tank at 7 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking. At the moment the two tanks hold the same amount of water, how many liters do they hold together?

Lucas, Greta, Elena, Noah and Ines collect seashells. Ines has 12 more seashells than Greta. A new album holds 120 seashells. Ines has 312 seashells. Maya has 180 seashells. How many seashells do Lucas and Noah have together?

Greta needs 18 sketchbooks and 8 sets of paints and will buy the whole order at one of two shops. At Bright Mart, a sketchbook costs $10 and a set of paints costs $10, and the whole bill gets 15% off at the till. Bright Mart also sells brushes at $5 each, but Greta does not need any. At Corner Store, a sketchbook costs $10 and a set of paints costs $11 with no discount on the bill, but every fifth sketchbook in an order is free. Last month Corner Store had 35% off everything. By buying the whole order at the cheaper shop, how many dollars does Greta save compared with the other shop?

At 6 p.m., the red tank contains 320 liters of water and the blue tank contains 569 liters. The blue tank stands 3 meters tall. From 6 p.m. on, a valve drains the blue tank at 180 liters per hour, and a crack in the red tank leaks 1 liters per minute. The hose is 28 meters long. Water from the mains costs 5 cents per liter. 20 minutes after 6 p.m., a hose starts filling the red tank at 9 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking. The red team, the blue team and the green team are selling raffle tickets at $4 each to raise money for the children's hospital. The grand prize, a $227 bicycle, was donated by a local shop. The red team sells 39 tickets. The blue team sells 10 more tickets than the red team. The green team sells 6 fewer than twice as many tickets as the blue team. The printer charged 9 cents for every ticket printed, and 300 tickets were printed in total, including the unsold ones. The draw takes place at 8 p.m. on Friday. The printing bill is paid out of the ticket money, the organizers also keep 10% of the total ticket sales for next year's event, and everything left goes to the children's hospital. How many dollars go to the children's hospital?

Carlow and Fenwick are 133 km apart by rail. A one-way ticket between the two towns costs $31. An express train leaves Carlow for Fenwick at 6:35 a.m. and runs at a steady 88 km/h. A freight train leaves Fenwick for Carlow at 6:50 a.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1000 meters per minute. Neither train stops on the way. The express train left from platform 3. How many kilometers from Fenwick are the trains when they pass each other?

A parking garage holds only motorcycles, cars and six-wheeled trucks. Altogether there are 12 vehicles with 52 wheels, and exactly 25% of the vehicles are six-wheeled trucks. The garage opens at 7 a.m. Six-wheeled trucks are charged $12 per hour each. Cars are charged $5 per hour each. The garage has room for 74 vehicles. How many dollars are collected from the cars if every one of them is parked for 6 hours?
